sentences.en: She's intent on going to New York to study fashion.
sentences.zh: 她一心想要去纽约学习时尚。

sentences.en: He was too intent on studying to hear my call.
sentences.zh: 他太专注于学习而没有听到我的呼唤。

sentences.en: It isn't my intent to hurt you in any way.
sentences.zh: 我无意以任何方式伤害你。

senses.zh: (目光)不能移的,集中的,专心的;坚决的
